questions.question: Describe your work developing next-generation intelligent down-hole oil drilling tools. What electrical design responsibilities did you own, and how did you validate the design in a harsh operating environment?

You have automated accelerometer and magnetometer calibration using LabVIEW and Python. How did you define calibration requirements, manage measurement uncertainty, and verify that the automation produced reliable results?

This role involves PLC control systems and control panels. What experience do you have designing or integrating control hardware, sensors, embedded controllers, or automated test systems, and how would you approach a PLC-based industrial control application?
Walk us through an automated test system you developed using LabVIEW or Python. What instruments, interfaces, test sequences, data handling, and failure reporting were involved?

What experience do you have creating electrical schematics using Cadence Schematic Editor, Virtuoso, or other CAD tools? How do you ensure that schematics are accurate, reviewable, and aligned with the physical implementation?
How would you approach the electrical design for a motor-driven process system, from incoming power distribution through motor control, field wiring, interlocks, and commissioning?

This position requires close attention to the National Electrical Code. Describe your familiarity with electrical codes and standards, and explain how you would confirm that an industrial facility design complies with applicable NEC requirements.
How would you read and use a process and instrumentation diagram (P&ID) to develop instrument connections, control logic, I/O requirements, alarms, and electrical design deliverables?

Describe a time you identified a technical issue or outlier in experimental or test data, such as your GPS or cotton-fiber research work. How did you investigate the issue and communicate the conclusion?

During construction, this role reviews shop drawings and supports testing and startup. How would you organize a review of contractor submittals and develop a field-testing and commissioning plan for electrical and control equipment?
